title: WELL bphotos gallery index (ug_1.htm) — only bphotos page indexed by search
description: Confirmation search for further people.well.com/user/jct/bphotos/ pages: search engines index only ug_1.htm, ug_n_son.htm and val_ol~2.htm (all already catalogued). The gallery is the photo section of Mahesh Bhatt's 'U.G. Krishnamurti: A Life' (20 photographs per the WELL download page bio.htm); credits Sajid Martin for scanning most photographs and the cover pictures, and Srinivas and Pai for scans of seven originals. No further bphotos pages surfaced; the 20-photo set may include unindexed filenames (lead for direct URL probing).

title: Stopped in Our Tracks — WELL cover page (sitcover.htm) with ugch.jpg
description: Cover page and table of contents for K. Chandrasekhar's 'Stopped in Our Tracks: Stories of U.G. in India' (Smriti Books, 2005, tr. from Telugu, ed. J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty, ISBN 9788187967767). The WELL file set includes an image named ugch.jpg (UG with Chandrasekhar?). Google Books also shows a front-cover thumbnail for the 2005 edition (id TVRWA5imaeoC). Photographer unknown; copyright presumably Chandrasekhar/Smriti.

title: Commons Category:Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti — 2 files (second file unidentified)
description: Commons parent categories report the category contains 2 files. Only File:UGKrishnamurti.jpg (author Giuliano Sauro, video capture, GFDL, uploaded 8 Nov 2007) is confirmed by search; the second file name did not surface. Lead: open the category page directly.

title: Kannada Wikipedia article ಯು. ಜಿ. ಕೃಷ್ಣಮೂರ್ತಿ — infobox image
description: Kannada Wikipedia biography (born 9 July 1918 Machilipatnam, died 22 March 2007). Infobox image not confirmed by search; most likely reuses Commons File:UGKrishnamurti.jpg (GFDL). Telugu, Gujarati, Marathi and Italian article infoboxes did not surface in search.

title: Mahesh Bhatt on X, 5 Sep 2017 — 'The man who built & shaped my life'
description: Tweet text: 'U.G. Krishnamurti....The man who built & shaped my life. The man who in his hours of death gave me a taste of life!!!' Search snippet does not confirm an attached photo; lead to open the status directly. Related: 23 Mar 2015 tweet announcing Tamil edition of 'UG Krishnamurti - A Life' with image link (status 579607713191198720).

title: Mahesh Bhatt on X, 2015 — Tamil edition of 'UG Krishnamurti: A Life' (cover photo)
description: Tweet 'UG Krishnamurti - A Life by Mahesh Bhatt now in Tamil !' with a pic.twitter image (t.co/3tzqGtcciR) — presumably the Tamil cover. Publisher not named in snippet (Kannadasan Pathippagam is the known Tamil UG publisher).

title: The Natural State (2026) — Upstate Films programme page (poster/still)
description: Upstate Films listing for the Woodstock Film Festival screening (8 pm Sat 17 Oct 2026, Orpheum Theater 1, Saugerties) of Matthew Dougherty's 99-min documentary built from Julie Thayer's 1989–2007 camcorder footage; co-executive producers Jane Campion and Mahesh Bhatt. Listing pages normally carry the film's key art/poster; image not confirmed by text search. thenaturalstate.film did not surface in search.

title: Deadline — Jane Campion & Matt Dougherty interview on 'The Natural State' (Telluride 2026) with stills
description: Deadline interview around the Telluride world premiere; article pages carry film stills/portraits (credit likely 'Courtesy of the filmmakers'/Telluride FF). Also: AWFJ review by Diane Carson (Telluride 2026), The Film Stage Woodstock review, NextBestPicture review, Unseen Films, Variety India piece quoting Mahesh Bhatt ('UG Krishnamurti has escaped'), Overlook News feature on the Hudson Valley WhatsApp group behind the film — each likely to embed a still.

title: Travels with UG (travelswithug.com) — Julie Thayer's photo journal site
description: Julie Thayer's site for 'Travels with UG / Get Lost and Stay Lost' (journal 1989–2007, cookbook). Journal One notes she took 'well over 300 photographs' of UG; blog ugunplugged names Thayer and Wendy Moorty as the two photographers behind 'the most wonderful pictures of UG'. No exhibition found. Site pages likely carry her photographs (copyright Julie Thayer).

title: Narayana Moorty's blog (March 2009) — Wendy Moorty photographing UG in Lalbagh; Carmel rental
description: Narayana Moorty recounts a walk with UG in Lalbagh gardens with 'Wendy following and taking a picture', and renting a Carmel vacation house for UG for a month. Blog posts may embed Wendy Moorty photographs. The WELL ug_1.htm gallery has 'In Carmel, USA, where the book was written' and a photo with Narayana Moorty (photographer unnamed, plausibly Wendy Moorty).

title: U.G. Krishnamurti TV (sites.google.com/view/ugtv) — resource index
description: Google Sites index of UG video resources linking people.well.com/user/jct and ugkrishnamurti.org; no stills confirmed in text search. Companion site sites.google.com/view/ugkrishnamurti/home.

title: U.G. at Yercaud (1995) — Internet Archive video (stills of the Yercaud house)
description: 1995 video of a discussion at UG's Yercaud residence (the 'colonial house', a 20x70 ft long house on a 100x100 ft plot per Chandrasekhar). Archive item thumbnail/frames are the only located imagery of the Yercaud house. No standalone photograph found.

title: No Way Out: Conversations with U.G. Krishnamurti — Smriti Books cover (Google Books thumbnail)
description: Smriti Books ed. (2002; Google Books gives 2005), 194 pp., ed. J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty & Antony Paul Frank Noronha, ISBN 9788187967088; Google Books record carries front-cover image. Original ed. 'Further Dialogues with U.G. Krishnamurti' published by Akshaya Publications, Bangalore (no cover located). No Sentient edition found; later reprints by e-artnow (2021) and DigiCat (2022) have their own generic covers (ids qt1hEAAAQBAJ, 9glzEAAAQBAJ).

title: The Courage to Stand Alone — Non-Duality Press 2013 cover (ed. Ellen Chrystal)
description: Non-Duality Press paperback, 140 pp., ISBN 9781908664280 (ernster.com attributes it to New Harbinger, its US distributor). Transcribed from the 1982 Amsterdam 'Give Up' tapes. Earlier Smriti Books 3rd ed. ISBN 8187967064 (readersend.com; AbeBooks lists SPB Enterprises 2001). Plover Press (original 1984 ed.) did not surface. e-artnow/DigiCat/Good Press reprints (ISBN 8027246571, 8027381010) carry generic covers.

title: Thought is Your Enemy — Sowmya Publishers 1990 / Smriti Books 2002 covers
description: Sowmya Publishers, Bangalore (1st print Oct 1990, 2nd Aug 1991), eds. Frank Noronha & J.S.R.L. Narayana Moorty, 95–108 pp. — Amazon ASIN B0006EYQS2 listing. Smriti Books revised ed. 2002, ISBN 8187967110, 123 pp. (Amazon.co.uk; Google Books id PGHXld75CCAC with cover thumbnail). holybooks.com hosts PDF with cover scan.

title: UG Says: Everyday Thoughts by UG Krishnamurti — HarperCollins India 2018 cover
description: Compiled by Arun Babani, foreword Mahesh Bhatt, intro Mukunda Rao; HarperCollins India, 212 pp., ISBN 9789353024833. Cover image on Amazon/Goodreads/Booktopia listings. Penguin 'The Little Book of Questions' did not surface in search.

title: The Other Side of Belief: Interpreting U.G. Krishnamurti — Penguin India 2005 cover
description: Ed. Mukunda Rao, foreword Mahesh Bhatt; Penguin Books India 2005, ISBN 9780144000357 (also 0670999415 hardback). Cover thumbnails on Google Books, AbeBooks and Amazon listings; cover design/photo credit not stated in search results.

title: Le mental est un mythe — Les Deux Océans 2000 cover (and Le dos au mur 2001, La Pensée est votre ennemie 1989)
description: French Deux Océans editions: 'Le mental est un mythe: entretiens déroutants' (tr. Paule Salvan, 2 May 2000, ISBN 9782866810238); 'Le dos au mur ou le mythe de la perfection' (tr. Jean-Michel Terdjman, 1 Oct 2001, ISBN 9782866810726); 'La Pensée est votre ennemie: entretiens fracassants' (1989, 127 pp.). Cover images on Babelio, librest.com, lamachinealire.com, motsetimages.fr listings. 'La mystique de l'illumination' not found as a Deux Océans title.

title: La mente è un mito — Aequilibrium (Italian) cover
description: 'La mente è un mito. Conversazioni sconcertanti con un uomo chiamato U.G.', Aequilibrium, tr. G. Turchi, 182–184 pp., ISBN 9788898365098 (listing date 1990; ISBN prefix suggests a later reprint). Cover images on IBS, laFeltrinelli, Hoepli, Il Giardino dei Libri. 'Non c'è via d'uscita' not found.

title: La mente es un mito — Editorial Sirio cover (2013 'Nueva portada'; 2017 ebook)
description: 'La mente es un mito: Inquietantes conversaciones con un hombre llamado U.G.', tr. Ricardo de Frutos Armesto, Editorial Sirio, 216 pp., ISBN 9788478088959 (new cover 15 Apr 2013); ebook ISBN 9788478089246 (2017), cover design Editorial Sirio S.A. Publisher page offers 'Portada HD' download.

title: Mythos Mind – Märchenhafter Verstand / Der trügerische Schein der Erleuchtung — Noumenon Verlag covers
description: German Noumenon Verlag editions: 'Mythos Mind – Märchenhafter Verstand: Beunruhigende Gespräche mit einem beunruhigenden Menschen' (hardcover 2010, ISBN 9783941973015) and 'Der trügerische Schein der Erleuchtung: Die radikalen Ideen eines radikalen Menschen' (Mar 2011, 220 pp., ISBN 9783941973077; Mystica.tv page). Cover images on buchfindr/booklooker listings. Earlier German 'Das Ende der Sehnsucht' text is on the WELL (GERMAN/Das_Ende_der_Sehnsucht).

title: De denkbeeldige geest — Samsara Uitgeverij 2004 cover (design Kees Schreuders)
description: Dutch translation of 'Mind is a Myth', tr. M. Bryant, Samsara, Sept 2004, 204 pp., ISBN 9789077228241; cover design credited to Kees Schreuders (per Scribd copy of front matter). Cover images on InZicht, De Slegte, Standaard Boekhandel, boekenwereld listings.

title: Ум — это миф / Ошибка просветления / Биология просветления — Ganga (Ганга) Russian covers
description: Ganga author page lists Russian editions: 'Ум — это миф. Беседы с У.Г. Кришнамурти' (2011, ISBN 978-5-98882-118-2; 2014 reprint 236 pp., series 'Не2'), 'Ошибка просветления' (ISBN 978-5-98882-094-9 / 978-5-906154-09-5), 'Биология просветления'. Cover images on ganga.ru, labirint.ru (books/448069, 333227), bookvoed.ru.

title: Umysł jest mitem (Thesaurus Press 1994) / Odwaga bycia samotnym (Limbus) / Myśl jest twoim wrogiem — Polish covers
description: 'Umysł jest mitem. Niepokojące rozmowy z człowiekiem zwanym U.G.' Thesaurus Press, Wrocław 1994, ISBN 8385812024, tr. Adam Sobota, Tomasz Rosca, Włodzimierz Ostrowski (soft cover; antykwariatnws listing). 'Odwaga bycia samotnym' Limbus 2010 ISBN 9788371911040 (series 'Nirvana', 2002 per nakanapie; Thesaurus 1992 ed. on Allegro). 'Myśl jest twoim wrogiem' (lubimyczytac 209307, taniaksiazka).

title: The Ashes Are Warm — Rupa 2026 cover (B&W photo of Mahesh Bhatt with UG)
description: 'The Ashes Are Warm: Memories of a Lifetime Spent with UG Krishnamurti', Mahesh Bhatt as told to Sunita Pant Bansal, Rupa Publications (Apr 2026, 352–384 pp.). Cover is a black-and-white photograph of Bhatt and UG. Cover image posted in Sunita Pant Bansal's preorder tweet and Rupa Books tweet (status 2056312023508762982); also Amazon UK Kindle listing B0GX2WTJ87, Storizen review, Tribune review.

title: Hindi editions — 'Na Khatm Honewali Kahani' (Vani Prakashan 1996) and 'Dimag Hi Dushman Hai'
description: ugkrishnamurti.in 'books about UG' page lists the Hindi translation of Bhatt's biography, 'Na Khatm Honewali Kahani', Vani Prakashan 1996. 'Dimag Hi Dushman Hai' (Thought is Your Enemy) appears with cover thumbnails on epustakalay.com and 44books.com (unofficial PDF sites). No Tamil Kannadasan Pathippagam, Telugu or Bengali covers surfaced.

title: Oneindia, 24 Mar 2007 — 'Renowned philosopher U G Krishnamurti passes away'
description: PTI/UNI wire report datelined Bangalore: died 22 Mar in 'Vallecorsia', Italy aged 89 at a friend's villa; cremation by Mahesh Bhatt without rituals; fall seven weeks earlier. Oneindia article pages carry a thumbnail photo (not confirmed by text search). The Hindu report 'U.G. Krishnamurti passes away' referenced on spiritualteachers.org (link only); Times of India/DNA not found.

title: Scroll.in 2017 — Parveen Babi / UG graphic-novel outtake panels
description: Scroll.in piece reproducing unused panels from a graphic-novel biography of UG imagining Parveen Babi's encounters with him (drawn, not photographic). No photograph of UG with Parveen Babi was found in search.

title: Flickr account 'UG Krishnamurti' (flickr.com/photos/ug) — 24 photos, none public
description: Flickr profile named 'UG Krishnamurti', joined 2006, 24 photos, 1 follower/1 following, but 'This user has no public photos'. Account owner not identified by search (2006 date suggests a Brawley/Thayer-circle friend during UG's last year). Licence unknown.

title: Flickr: 'ug_4_046 — My Favourite Portrait of U.G Krishnamurti' (Santhosh Samarthyam)
description: Portrait of UG uploaded by Flickr user Santhosh Samarthyam, captioned 'My Favourite Portrait of U.G Krishnamurti'. Filename ug_4_046 suggests a scan from a numbered series (possibly the WELL/Chandrasekhar set). Photographer and licence not stated in search.

title: YouTube: 'U.G. Krishnamurti Family Photos' slideshow
description: YouTube slideshow of UG family photographs (childhood/family era); uploader and sources not confirmed. Lead for childhood/Theosophical-era images, which did not surface elsewhere (Adyar archive searches return only Jiddu Krishnamurti).

title: 'Remembrance — UG and Valentine' PDF, incl. 'Valentine on the terrace of chalet Sunbeam, Gstaad'
description: Illustrated PDF 'Remembrance – UG and Valentine' with photographs and text fragments on UG and Valentine; carries caption 'Valentine on the terrace of chalet Sunbeam, Gstaad' — the only located image of Chalet Sunbeam (UG's summer residence for ~25 years, two-storey, landlord Herr Grossman, overlooking the Gstaad tennis courts per Narayana Moorty). Compiler/photographers not identified; likely scans from Chandrasekhar/Moorty circle.

title: YouTube: 'U.G. Krishnamurti with friends – Gstaad (Switzerland) 1992' (edit by Enzo de Ruvo)
description: Home-video footage of UG with friends in Gstaad 1992, edited by Enzo de Ruvo; source for stills of UG at Chalet Sunbeam/Gstaad in the 1990s. Friends not named in listing.

title: The Natural State — Festival Trailer 2026 (YouTube)
description: Official festival trailer for Matthew Dougherty's 'The Natural State' (US, 2026, 99 min); frames from Julie Thayer's 1989–2007 camcorder footage. Thumbnail serves as key art. Related: Hammer to Nail interview with Dougherty, Screen Daily and Variety Telluride lineup announcements, Variety India review ('Decoding India's Fiercest Anti-Guru').

title: The Little Book of Questions — Penguin India 2000 cover (comp. Mahesh Bhatt)
description: Quotation anthology compiled/edited with foreword by Mahesh Bhatt; Penguin Books India, 144 pp., ISBN 9780140299380 (dates 1999–Oct 2000 across listings). Cover thumbnails on Amazon, Blackwell's, Google Books (-ZRbAAAACAAJ). Spanish ed. 'Destellos de sabiduría' (Luz de Luna, Argentina 2003).

title: The Natural State: In the Words of U.G. Krishnamurti — Smriti Books 2005/2006 cover (comp. Peter Maverick)
description: Anthology compiled by Peter Maverick; Smriti Books (PSB Enterprises) softcover 2005 ISBN 9788187967774, hardcover Dec 2006 ISBN 9788187967804. Cover images on Amazon, AbeBooks, Google Books (07ae6Ow6O-YC). e-artnow 2021 / Musaicum 2022 reprints have generic covers.

title: Telugu: 'యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి – జీవితం – తాత్వికత' cover (Exotic India) and 'ఎవరీ యు.జి. కృష్ణమూర్తి' (J.S. Subrahmanyam, Pothi)
description: Telugu biography/philosophy volume listed with cover photo on Exotic India (item HAZ053); J.S. Subrahmanyam's 'Evaree U.G. Krishnamurti' on Pothi.com with cover; WELL hosts Subrahmanyam's Telugu 'About UG' PDF. Publisher details not in snippets.

title: Italian Wikipedia 'Uppaluri Gopala Krishnamurti' — infobox image
description: Italian article (born Machilipatnam, died Vallecrosia; 'antiguru'; disambiguation from Jiddu). Infobox image presumably Commons UGKrishnamurti.jpg (Giuliano Sauro, CC BY-SA 3.0/GFDL). Telugu, Gujarati and Marathi Wikipedia articles did not surface in search.

title: U.G. with Dr. Larry Morris (1992, Albuquerque) — Internet Archive video (stills)
description: Archive.org video 'U.G. with Dr. Larry Morris (2/2)' recorded 1992 in Albuquerque; thumbnail/frames show UG with Morris (author of 'U.G. Krishnamurti: Dangerous Friend', 2015, whose cover also carries a UG photo — Goodreads 25880413). WELL ug_1.htm caption 'In California, with Terry Newland, Robert Carr, Douglas Rosenstein and Paul Lynn' is the only located Newland image. No Palm Springs or Mill Valley house photos found.

title: Louis Brawley — Buddha at the Gas Pump #177 page (photos; links to Brawley's site/blog)
description: BatGap interview page for Louis Brawley (artist/photographer who met UG in 2002 and travelled with him 2002–07; author of 'Goner', Non-Duality Press 2011/2013 — New Harbinger product page carries the cover). Page links 'Louis' Website' and 'Louis' blog', the likeliest hosts of his UG photographs; neither surfaced directly in search.
